text:
erin: During today's POC demo the customer hit 429s while running an embeddings bulk import + live chat demo. They said it happened right after they kicked off a 10k vector upload and started the scripted chat flows (~40 concurrent users).

erin: Customer log (snippet):
```
[2026-03-22T16:02:15Z] req=02ABCD12 status=429 route=/v1/embeddings model=embed-x large_batch=10240 tenant=big-retail
[2026-03-22T16:02:16Z] req=02ABCD13 status=429 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-chat tokens=980 tenant=big-retail
```

tom: Thanks, pinging eng-platform. Do we know if this was the token_budget or an explicit per-route cap?

lucy: SRE summary: auto-alert fired for token_budget exhaustion. Tenant big-retail on trial has token_budget_per_min=120000 and route_caps default (generate 0.6, embeddings 0.5). The simultaneous embedding job consumed >60k tokens in 30s, plus chat tails pushed over the minute.

sre-bot: ALERT: tenant=big-retail | token usage spike 16:01-16:03 UTC | 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | burst_window=5s | top routes=/v1/embeddings,/v1/generate

maria: For demos we usually do: 1) temporary quota bump or 2) offload embeddings to a background job with throttling. Can we propose a quick unblock?

jordan: Proposing a 45-minute temporary policy change: set token_budget_per_min=250000 and increase burst_window_seconds=12 for this tenant; add a hard per-route cap to embeddings=0.35 so chat isn't starved. Will monitor.

tom: If we do that, let's also enable route_priority so chat routes get preferential scheduling over embeddings during bursts. That can prevent UX breaks without requiring permanent quota changes.

lucy: Admin call ready. Tom/maria, please approve.

maria: Approved. Jordan please apply with canary flag and post change id. Also tag the support engineer on the customer side to coordinate.

jordan: Applied canary: change_id=chg_20260322_007. Details: token_budget_per_min=250000, burst_window_seconds=12, route_caps: generate=0.65, embeddings=0.35, route_priority: {"/v1/generate":"high","/v1/embeddings":"normal"}. Monitoring: 30s granularity for first 15m.

erin: Customer confirmed demo resumed and no new 429s in the next 20m. They said the chat latency improved.

lucy: Follow-ups: 1) Solutions to share a POC runbook (recommended vector batch sizes and concurrency limits), 2) Product: consider a "demo mode" toggle that sets conservative route caps + increased short-term budget, 3) Finance: flag potential billing note for the trial bump.

tom: Also note this pattern: large embedding imports during demos are common. For longer term, we should offer a managed-import path that queues embeddings and respects tenant headroom and model-cost tiering.

maria: Filing issues: ENG-3219 (demo-runbook), ENG-3220 (demo-mode toggle in console UX), ENG-3221 (managed embeddings import feature).

erin: I'll follow up with the customer about recommended settings for their next demo and share the temporary change id.

jordan: Canary will auto-roll back after 45 minutes unless sales asks to extend. change_id=chg_20260322_007.

erin: Thanks all 44d closing thread unless anything else shows up.
